# Growth of recommend time with the number of users (generated by tools/growth.py)

Fit t = a * N^b on the 25%, 50% and 100% scalability runs (4 cores, one machine); N = evaluated users (130,411 at 100%). Prediction for 10x the users keeps the catalogue fixed.

| Method | Exponent b | R^2 | Time at 100% (s) | Predicted at 10x users (s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| popularity | 0.18 | 0.973 | 4.11 | 6 |
| exact kNN | 1.69 | 1.000 | 132.33 | 6,366 |
| LSH | 1.75 | 0.998 | 535.49 | 30,864 |
| PPR | 0.86 | 0.953 | 142.84 | 951 |
| ALS | 0.99 | 1.000 | 385.66 | 3,738 |

- LSH vs exact kNN: exponents 1.75 vs 1.69; no crossing: the approximation grows at least as fast.
